_meta.paper: Randles, C. A. et al. (2013): Intercomparison of shortwave radiative transfer schemes to improve the aerosol and surface albedo treatment in climate models. Atmospheric Chemistry and Physics, 13, 2347-2362.
_meta.protocol: Case 1 Rayleigh-only; Case 2a AOD550 0.2, Angstroem 1, SSA 1.0, g 0.7; Case 2b SSA 0.8 (rest same as 2a). Surface albedo 0.2 Lambert. SZA 30/75 deg. AFGL subarctic winter (saw) + tropics (trop). Aerosol confined to lowest 2 km, linearly decreasing to zero at 2 km. No clouds.
_meta.normalization: Each model divides its own band TOA incident flux and multiplies by the LBL median constants (removes the solar-constant choice).

thresholds.case2a_atmospheric_rf: report-only (<1 W/m2; RSD invalid per paper)

_meta.quantity_naming: Quantities tagged bb refer to the 0.2-4.0 um broadband, uvvis to 0.2-0.7 um. toa_rf/sfc_rf are broadband case-2 minus case-1 differences. Config keys: {saw,trop}{30,75}.
